senses.gloss: विवेक-वि- + गुण विवेक-वि- + गुण, adj. contrary to reason, unreasonable, Rājat. 5, 352.
विवेक- + पदवी विवेक- + पदवी, f. reflexion, Kathās. 33, 81.

वि- + वर्ण वि- + वर्ण,
 I. adj. 1. wanting colour, pale, Nal. 2, 2. 2. bad-coloured. 3. changing colour. 4. low.
 II. m. a man of a low caste.

वि- + वश वि- + वश, adj., f. शा (deprived of will). 1. subject, subjected, Rām. 3, 55, 51; Hit. i. d. 171, M.M. (even against their will). 2. independent. 3. uncontrolled, unsubdued. 4. apprehensive of death, Bhartṛ. 2, 29. 5. desirous of death, having the soul free from worldly cares, dead, Ragh. 8, 81.

विवास विवास, i. e.
 I. वि- 1. वस्, Caus., + अ, m. Banishment, Nal. 19, 6.
 II. वि-वास, adj. Without clothes, naked.
वि- + वस्त्र वि- + वस्त्र, adj. deprived of clothes, naked, Lass. 14, 7.
वि- + विध वि- + विध, adj. various, of many sorts, Pañc. 192, 22; manifold, Vikr. d. 46.

विवक्षा विवक्षा, i. e. विवक्ष, desider. of वच्, + अ, f.
 1. Wish to speak.
 2. Wish.
 3. A question, MBh. 1, 7197.

विवध and वीवध वी̆वध, probably वि-वह् + अ, m.
 1. A road, Pañc. iii. d. 39 (वि˚).
 2. A yoke for carrying burthens.
 3. A load.
 4. Storing grain or hay, etc.
 5. An ewer.
 --Comp.
वीवध वीवध, and वीवधिक वीवधिक, see विवध, विवधिक.
विवधिक and वीवधिक वी̆वधिक, i. e. वी̆वध + इक, m. A chandler.

विवर विवर, i. e. वि-वृ + अ, n.
 1. Separation.
 2. A hole, Hit. 28, 10, M.M.; a chasm, a fissure, Pañc. 10, 12; a breach, Man. 7, 105; an interval, Śāk. d. 166; space, Nalod. 2, 19.
 3. A cave, Pañc. 241, 1.
 4. A vulnerable part, MBh. 9, 3280.
 5. A wound, Ragh. 11, 18.
 6. Fault, defect.
 --Comp.

विवरण विवरण, i. e. वि-वृ + अन, n.
 1. Uncovering.
 2. Explanation.
 3. A sentence, Brahmav. 2, 28.
 4. Detailing.

विवर्त विवर्त, i. e. वि-वृत् + अ, m.
 1. Going round, Lass. 74, 16; revolving.
 2. Dancing.
 3. Confounding of truth and falsehood, mistaking unreal objects and conceiving them to be what they are not, e. g. mirage for water, Vedāntas. in Chr. 211, 24.
 4. Object as unreal, opposed to Brahman, the only real essence, Utt. Rāmac. 143, 8.
 5. Modification, Utt. Rāmac. 37, 3; 88, 2. []
 6. An assemblage, multitude, Mālat. 24, 8.

विवर्तन विवर्तन, i. e. वि-वृत् + अन, n.
 1. Going round, revolving.
 2. Reverential salutation, Kir. 5, 40.
 3. Turning round, overturning, Utt. Rāmac. 102, 4.
 4. Tossing to and fro, Śāk. d. 132.
 5. Returning, Kir. 7, 11.
 6. Passing in succession, Mālat. 23, 14; as various hells, Man. 12, 75.
 7. Being, abiding.
 8. Causing to change, Mālat. 71, 8.

विवर्तिन् विवर्तिन्, i. e. वि-वृत् + इन्, adj. Turning back, Śāk. d. 73; Kir. 5, 5.
 --Comp.

विवर्धन विवर्धन, i. e. वि-वृध् + अन,
 I. adj.
 1. Growing, Rām. 3, 49, 41.
 2. Furthering, increasing, Man. 1, 106; Hit. ii. d. 57 (but cf. v. r. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1217).
 II. n. Increase.

विवस्वन्त् वि-वस् + वन्त्, (2. वस्)
 I. m.
 1. The sun, Pañc. v. d. 37; Kir. 5, 48.
 2. Aruṇa, the charioteer of the sun.
 3. The seventh Manu (see वैवस्वत).
 4. A god.
 II. f. वती, The city of the sun.
विवाक विवाक, see प्राड्विवाक.

विवाद विवाद, i. e. वि-वद् + अ, m.
 1. Contesting, Śāk. 106, 10; contest, strife, Man. 4, 180; dispute, Pañc. i. d. 68.
 2. Argument, Man. 11, 205.
 3. A lawsuit, Pañc. iii. d. 92.
 4. Sound, Ragh. 18, 42.
 --Comp.

विवादिन् विवादिन्, i. e. विवाद + इन्, adj. and sbst.
 1. Contending.
 2. A party in a lawsuit, Man. 8, 69.
विवासन विवासन, i. e. वि- 1. वस्, Caus., + अन, n. Banishment, banishing, Utt. Rāmac. 41, 5.

विवाह विवाह, i. e. वि-वह् + अ, m.
 1. Marriage, Pañc. 188, 22.
 2. Nuptial form, Man. 3, 20.
 --Comp.
 see कु-, दुस्-, m. a bad form of marriage, Man. 3, 41.
ऽविवाहिन् -विवाहिन्, i. e. विवाह + इन्, in अ-, adj. Such one who is forbidden to be allied by marriage, Man. 9, 238.
विविंशति विविंशति, m. A proper name.
विविक्तता वि-विक्त + ता (vb. विच्), f. A free or empty space, Rājat. 5, 354.
विविक्षु विविक्षु, i. e. विविक्ष, desider. of विश्, + उ, adj. Desiring to enter, Vikr. d. 24.
विवीत वि-वीत (vb. वी, substitute for अज्), n. A pasture ground, Yājñ. 2, 282.

विवृति वि-वृ + ति, f.
 1. Discovery, manifestation, Kir. 10, 19.
 2. Explanation.
विवृत्ति वि-वृत् + ति, f. Turning round, rolling, whirling, tumbling.
विवृद्धि विवृद्धि, i. e. वि-वृध् + ति, f. Growth, increase. Man. 1, 31.

विवेक विवेक, i. e. वि-विच् + अ, m.
 1. Discrimination, Man. 1, 26; Pañc. i. d. 294.
 2. Judgment, Bhartṛ. 2, 10.
 3. Discussion, investigation.
 4. True knowledge, Bhartṛ. 1, 89.
 5. A reservoir.
 --Comp.
विवेकज्ञ विवेक-ज्ञ, adj. Intelligent, Pañc. i. d. 431.
विवेकता विवेक + ता, in अ-, f. Want of judgment, Hit. pr. d. 11, M.M. निस्-विवेकत्व, see s. v. निर्वि˚.

विवेकिन् विवेकिन्, i. e. विवेक + इन्, adj. Judicious, discriminative, prudent, Pañc. 131, 19.
 --Comp.
विवेक्तृ विवेक्तृ, i. e. वि-विच् + तृ, m. A wise man, Rājat. 5, 5.

विवेचन विवेचन, i. e. वि-रिच् + अन, n.
 1. Discrimination.
 2. Decision, Man. 8, 21.

विवोढृ विवोढृ, i. e. वि-वह् + तृ, m.
 1. A husband.
 2. A bridegroom.
विव्वोक विव्वोक, m. Affectation of indifference, one of the feminine actions, tending to excite love, Sāh. Darp. 284, 20.
